draft.shortGloss: to see; to watch; to look
notes: Use 'sehen' for the general ability to see or noticing something with your eyes. If you are deliberately directing your focus toward something, use 'schauen' or 'gucken' instead.
Do not confuse this with 'aussehen', which means 'to look' in the sense of 'to appear' (e.g., 'Du siehst müde aus' - 'You look tired').

senses.definition: To notice or perceive something with your eyes.
